# TransformerPath

> An independent global information platform for the transformer industry.

Expanded map of citeable pages. Each line uses the description already published on that page.

## Directory

- [Directory](https://transformerpath.com/directory.html): A sourced transformer-industry sourcing directory — find and filter transformer manufacturers, component and material suppliers, verify capability evidence, compare factually, then RFQ.
- [Manufacturers](https://transformerpath.com/manufacturers.html): A growing, sourced directory of transformer manufacturers — power, distribution and dry-type/cast-resin makers listed country by country.

## Tenders

- [Transformer Tenders — open bids](https://transformerpath.com/tenders.html): Open transformer bids sorted by close time, each with an official notice link and the close shown in the portal zone and Asia/Dubai.
- [Transformer tenders by country](https://transformerpath.com/tenders/countries.html): Country pages for 64 transformer tender markets.

## Lead times and factory capacity

- [Grid lead-time tracker by class and region](https://transformerpath.com/lead-times/): Free public summary of typical transformer lead times by class and by region.
- [Lead times and factory capacity](https://transformerpath.com/factory-capacity/): Free tracker of transformer lead times and factory capacity.

## Events

- [Industry Events — global calendar](https://transformerpath.com/events.html): Global transformer & power industry exhibitions and conferences 2026–2028 — CWIEME, CIGRE, Middle East Energy, ELECRAMA, Enlit, WETEX and more.

## Guides

- [Practical transformer guides](https://transformerpath.com/guides/): Original guides on buying, testing, and operating power transformers.
- [Cooling codes and temperature rise](https://transformerpath.com/guides/cooling-and-temperature-rise/): How the four-letter transformer cooling code works, and why IEC 60076-2 and IEEE C57.12.00 temperature-rise limits must not be mixed.
- [How to read a dissolved-gas result](https://transformerpath.com/guides/dissolved-gas-analysis/): What the common dissolved gases in transformer oil point to, and why IEC 60599 and IEEE C57.104 do not treat one sample as a diagnosis.
- [Factory acceptance tests to name in the contract](https://transformerpath.com/guides/factory-acceptance-tests/): Which routine, type, and special tests IEC 60076-1 and IEEE C57.12.90 cover, and which records to take away from the factory.
- [Frequency-response traces and winding movement](https://transformerpath.com/guides/frequency-response-analysis/): How a factory frequency-response baseline is compared after transport or a through-fault, using IEC 60076-18 and IEEE C57.149.
- [Accepting new and in-service insulating liquid](https://transformerpath.com/guides/insulating-liquid-acceptance/): How to specify and accept mineral oil and esters in a transformer, and why the voltage class changes the limit in IEC 60422 and IEEE C57.106.
- [Loading a transformer above its nameplate rating](https://transformerpath.com/guides/loading-above-nameplate/): How IEC 60076-7 and IEEE C57.91 treat hot-spot temperature, insulation aging, and loading above the nameplate power.
- [How to read a power transformer nameplate](https://transformerpath.com/guides/reading-a-transformer-nameplate/): What each line on a power transformer nameplate means before you buy, test, or load the unit, and which IEC and IEEE standards define those lines.
- [Site tests before first energization](https://transformerpath.com/guides/site-tests-before-energization/): The checks to make on a power transformer after transport and before the first voltage, using IEC and IEEE field-test practice.
- [What belongs in a transformer inquiry](https://transformerpath.com/guides/transformer-inquiry/): The ratings, insulation levels, cooling, losses, and tests to state in a power transformer inquiry before a manufacturer is asked for a price.
- [US and EU grid equipment rules for transformer buyers](https://transformerpath.com/guides/us-eu-grid-equipment/): Free summary of the US bulk-power equipment order and the EU texts on high-risk suppliers, for transformer buyers.
- [Vector group, clock number, and paralleling](https://transformerpath.com/guides/vector-group-and-paralleling/): How IEC clock numbers and IEEE angular displacement describe transformer connections, and what must match before two units share a bus.

## Learn

- [Learn Transformer Design — Course Matched to the Books](https://transformerpath.com/learn.html): Learn transformer design, operations, diagnostics, manufacturing and HVDC — the 26-chapter design course plus a book-matched series path (Volumes 0–22, all coming soon).

## Calculators

- [Design calculator](https://transformerpath.com/calculator.html): An analytical transformer design workspace (BETA / engineering review) with a leakage-field solver; first-pass core, turns and conductor sizing runs analytically.
